name: Mediterranean Chickpea Bowls
description: A quick plant-based bowl with lemon, vegetables, and chickpeas.
instructions: Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Dice the cucumber and tomatoes.
Toss everything with lemon juice and olive oil.

name: Chicken and Rice Skillet
description: A simple one-pan chicken dinner with rice and vegetables.
instructions: Brown the chicken in a large skillet.
Add vegetables and cook until softened.
Add rice and stock, cover, and simmer until cooked.

name: Creamy Tomato Pasta
description: Comforting vegetarian pasta with tomato and cream.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.
Simmer chopped tomato and onion until saucy.
Stir in cream, pasta, and parmesan.

name: Tofu Vegetable Stir-Fry
description: Crisp tofu and vegetables in a savory ginger sauce.
instructions: Sear cubed tofu until crisp.
Stir-fry the vegetables.
Add tofu, soy sauce, and ginger and toss.

name: Spaghetti alla Carbonara
description: The Roman classic built on eggs, cured pork, and sharp sheep's cheese.
instructions: Boil the spaghetti in well-salted water and reserve a cup of the cooking liquid.
Render the diced pancetta with the crushed garlic until crisp, then discard the garlic.
Whisk the eggs with the grated pecorino and plenty of black pepper.
Toss the drained pasta with the pancetta off the heat, then add the egg mixture and loosen with pasta water until glossy.

name: Risotto ai Funghi
description: Creamy northern Italian mushroom risotto finished with butter and parmesan.
instructions: Saute the sliced mushrooms until browned and set them aside.
Soften the diced onion in butter, add the rice, and toast for two minutes.
Pour in the wine and let it evaporate, then add warm stock one ladle at a time.
Stir the mushrooms back in and finish off the heat with the remaining butter and parmesan.

name: Coq au Vin
description: Burgundian chicken braised slowly in red wine with bacon and mushrooms.
instructions: Crisp the diced bacon in a heavy pot and set it aside.
Brown the chicken thighs in the rendered fat, then remove them.
Cook the onion, carrot, and mushrooms until coloured, then deglaze with the red wine.
Return the chicken and bacon with the stock and thyme and braise gently until tender.

name: Ratatouille Provencale
description: Slow-cooked Provencal summer vegetables with garlic, thyme, and olive oil.
instructions: Cut every vegetable into even chunks and salt the eggplant briefly.
Cook each vegetable separately in olive oil so it keeps its own texture.
Combine everything with the garlic, chopped tomatoes, and thyme.
Simmer uncovered until thick and glossy, then rest before serving.

name: Chicken Teriyaki Donburi
description: Glazed Japanese chicken served over steamed rice with scallions.
instructions: Steam the rice while you prepare the chicken.
Sear the thighs skin-side down until golden, then turn and cook through.
Add the soy sauce, mirin, sugar, and grated ginger and reduce to a sticky glaze.
Slice the chicken over the rice and finish with sliced scallion.

name: Miso Ramen with Tofu
description: A warming miso broth with noodles, seared tofu, corn, and scallion.
instructions: Sear the cubed tofu in sesame oil until golden on all sides.
Warm the stock with the minced garlic, then whisk in the miso paste off the boil.
Cook the noodles separately and divide them between two bowls.
Ladle over the broth and top with tofu, corn, and sliced scallion.

name: Feijoada de Panela
description: Brazil's black bean and smoked pork stew, brightened with orange.
instructions: Brown the cubed pork, sliced sausage, and bacon in a heavy pot.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until fragrant.
Stir in the beans with their liquid, the bay leaves, and enough water to cover.
Simmer until the pork is tender, then squeeze in the orange juice and serve with rice.

name: Moqueca de Peixe
description: Bahian fish stew simmered in coconut milk, peppers, and lime.
instructions: Marinate the fish in lime juice and salt for fifteen minutes.
Layer sliced onion, pepper, and tomato in a wide pot with the palm oil.
Set the fish on top, pour over the coconut milk, and simmer gently without stirring.
Finish with chopped cilantro and serve with rice.

name: Smoky BBQ Pulled Chicken Sandwiches
description: Shredded barbecue chicken piled onto buns with a crunchy vinegar slaw.
instructions: Rub the chicken with smoked paprika and brown sugar and roast until tender.
Shred the meat with two forks and fold through the barbecue sauce.
Toss the shredded cabbage with the vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Pile the chicken into toasted buns and top with the slaw.

name: New England Clam Chowder
description: A thick East Coast chowder with clams, potatoes, bacon, and cream.
instructions: Render the diced bacon, then soften the onion in the fat with the butter.
Stir in the flour and cook briefly to make a roux.
Add the diced potatoes and the clam juice and simmer until the potatoes are soft.
Pour in the cream with the clams and thyme and warm through without boiling.

name: Chicken Tinga Tacos
description: Smoky chipotle chicken shredded into warm corn tortillas.
instructions: Poach the chicken until cooked through, then shred it and keep the broth.
Blend the tomatoes, garlic, and chipotle into a smooth sauce.
Fry the sliced onion, add the sauce, and simmer until it darkens.
Fold the chicken through the sauce and serve in warm tortillas with lime and cilantro.

name: Black Bean and Sweet Potato Enchiladas
description: Baked vegetarian enchiladas with roasted sweet potato and melting cheddar.
instructions: Roast the diced sweet potato until caramelised at the edges.
Mix it with the drained beans, softened onion, and cumin.
Roll the filling into the tortillas and pack them into a baking dish.
Cover with the enchilada sauce and cheddar and bake until bubbling.

name: Chana Masala
description: North Indian chickpea curry in a spiced tomato and onion masala.
instructions: Fry the finely chopped onion until deeply golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, turmeric, and garam masala and cook until fragrant.
Stir in the chopped tomatoes and cook down into a thick masala.
Add the chickpeas with a splash of water and simmer, then finish with cilantro.

name: Butter Chicken
description: Yogurt-marinated chicken in a mellow tomato, butter, and cream sauce.
instructions: Marinate the chicken in the yogurt with half the garam masala, garlic, and ginger.
Grill or sear the chicken until charred at the edges.
Simmer the tomatoes with the butter and remaining spices, then blend until smooth.
Return the chicken to the sauce, stir through the cream, and warm gently.

name: Thai Green Curry with Tofu
description: Fragrant coconut green curry with tofu, eggplant, and basil.
instructions: Fry the curry paste in the thick cream from the top of the coconut milk.
Add the remaining coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Cook the eggplant and pepper in the sauce until just tender, then add the tofu.
Finish with torn basil and a squeeze of lime.

name: Pad Thai with Shrimp
description: Rice noodles tossed in a sweet-sour tamarind sauce with shrimp and peanuts.
instructions: Soak the rice noodles in hot water until pliable, then drain.
Whisk the tamarind paste and fish sauce into a sauce.
Stir-fry the shrimp over high heat, push them aside, and scramble the eggs.
Add the noodles and sauce, toss until coated, then fold in the sprouts.
Serve with crushed peanuts and lime wedges.

name: Spanish Potato Tortilla
description: A thick Spanish omelette of slow-cooked potato and onion in olive oil.
instructions: Poach the thinly sliced potato and onion gently in the olive oil until soft, not browned.
Drain them and fold into the beaten eggs with the garlic and a good pinch of salt.
Cook the mixture in a small pan over low heat until the base is set.
Invert onto a plate, slide back in, and finish the second side. Rest before slicing and scatter with parsley.

name: Greek Lemon Chicken and Potatoes
description: One-pan roast chicken and potatoes with lemon, oregano, and garlic.
instructions: Toss the potato wedges and chicken with olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and oregano.
Arrange everything in a single layer and pour the stock around the edges.
Roast at high heat, basting once, until the potatoes are golden and the chicken is cooked.
Rest for five minutes and spoon over the pan juices.

name: Vegetable Tagine with Couscous
description: Moroccan spiced vegetables and chickpeas with dried apricots over couscous.
instructions: Soften the onion, then toast the ras el hanout until aromatic.
Add the carrot, zucchini, chickpeas, apricots, and two cups of stock.
Cover and simmer until the vegetables are tender and the sauce has thickened.
Steam the couscous with the remaining hot stock, fluff with a fork, and top with the tagine.

name: Mapo Tofu
description: Sichuan silken tofu in a numbing chili bean sauce with minced pork.
instructions: Toast and grind the sichuan peppercorns.
Brown the ground pork, then add the doubanjiang, garlic, and ginger.
Pour in a little water with the soy sauce and slide in the cubed tofu.
Simmer briefly, then scatter with scallion and the ground peppercorn.

name: Vegetable Bibimbap
description: Korean rice bowl with seasoned vegetables, a fried egg, and gochujang.
instructions: Steam the rice and keep it warm.
Cook the spinach, sprouts, julienned carrot, and mushrooms separately, dressing each with sesame oil and salt.
Arrange the vegetables in sections over the rice.
Top each bowl with a fried egg and a spoonful of gochujang, then mix at the table.

name: Chicken Pho
description: Vietnamese noodle soup with a clear aromatic broth of charred ginger and spice.
instructions: Char the halved onion and the ginger directly over a flame until blackened.
Simmer them in the stock with the star anise and cinnamon, then strain.
Poach the chicken in the broth, remove, and slice thinly.
Season the broth with fish sauce and ladle over cooked rice noodles and chicken.

name: Mujadara with Crispy Onions
description: Levantine lentils and rice buried under deeply caramelised onions.
instructions: Fry the thinly sliced onions slowly in olive oil until dark and crisp, then drain.
Simmer the lentils until almost tender and drain, keeping the liquid.
Add the rice and cumin with the reserved liquid and steam until both are cooked.
Fold half the onions through and pile the rest on top with parsley and lemon.

name: Lomo Saltado
description: Peruvian stir-fried beef with onion, tomato, and fries served over rice.
instructions: Fry the potato batons until crisp and keep them warm.
Sear the sliced beef in a very hot pan in batches so it browns rather than steams.
Add the onion wedges and tomato, then the soy sauce and aji amarillo paste.
Toss the fries through at the last moment and serve over rice with cilantro.
